newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain slow in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain slow in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European mealsna and feeds market remained slow this afternoon despite a weaker dollar, market sources said.
"We only saw a few trades in Argentine sunmeal and EU rapemeal. Generally it was a dull day as there was no faith in the market and Mondays are usually slow," one broker said.
Calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening also failed to spark activity.

April Argentine sunmeal pellets traded $1 up at $145 a tonne cif Rotterdam and July/Sept at $148. May EU rapemeal changed hands at 31.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
